citation: Dorogovtsev VN, Yankevich DS, Goswami N. Effects of an Innovative Head-Up Tilt Protocol on Blood Pressure and Arterial Stiffness Changes. J Clin Med. 2021;10(6):1198.
protocol: Standardised passive head-up tilt (tilt angle set from height so the hydrostatic column is 133 cm): 10 min lying horizontal, 10 min tilted, 10 min horizontal again. Haemodynamics averaged over minutes 6-10 of each position. The first horizontal block (after 10 min rest) is the baseline.
population: 40 young healthy volunteers (23 M, 17 F), age 25.1 +/- 2.6 y, BMI 24.7 +/- 3.6; without arterial hypertension, atherosclerosis or diabetes.
note: The baseline column is headed "Horizontal 1" (lying horizontal, not written as supine), so confirm it fits the supine definition. Table 2 HR for the tilt column differs from the value in the text, so use the baseline column only.
